name: Idaho Eats: Restaurants
subtitle: Finger Steaks, Basque & Spuds
description:
Idaho's restaurants, and the finger steaks worth the drive.

Idaho Eats is a free guide to eating in Idaho: Basque kitchens on Boise's Basque Block, finger steaks and drive-ins, spud plates, huckleberry shakes, Idaho trout, taquerías and historic saloons, each checked by hand, plus Idaho's James Beard honorees and 4,006 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries in 192 towns. No account, no ads.

IDAHO GUIDES
• Basque: chorizo, solomo and croquetas on Boise's Basque Block, and Basque kitchens elsewhere.
• Finger Steaks & Drive-Ins: battered strips of steak with fry sauce, and drive-in burgers.
• Spud Plates: potato specialties on the menu, from loaded bakers to the Pioneer Saloon's Jim Spud.
• Huckleberry: shakes, pies and pancakes, mostly in North Idaho and the mountains.
• Idaho Trout: rainbow trout from the Magic Valley and beyond.
• Taquerías: from Nampa and Caldwell to Burley.
• Historic Saloons: old bars and supper clubs from Wallace to Stanley.
• James Beard Honors: winners, nominees, semifinalists and America's Classics, as facts.
• Oldest Places: founding years checked at the same address, oldest first.

FIND IT FAST
• Sort by distance, or browse the map by guide.
• Search by name, town, street or dish: "finger steaks boise", "huckleberry shake", "basque".
• Filter by town or cuisine, hide chains.
• Save places for your next trip.
• Find hand-checked and honored places from iPhone search (Spotlight).

LIVE DETAILS FROM APPLE MAPS
Tap "Ratings, hours & photos" on any place to open Apple Maps' own place card, with current hours, photos, ratings and directions.

HOW THE LISTS ARE BUILT
Every place in a guide was checked by hand in fall 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source: the place's own website or menu, or local news. The rest of the restaurants come from Overture Maps open data, kept by a reliability rule tested against a full city list of licensed food businesses (Denver's, for the same map data). Website links are checked too: each must be the restaurant's own page. Idaho's health districts don't publish inspection results in bulk, so each place links its district's own lookup instead. Nothing is ranked by star ratings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location, if you share it, only sorts lists on your device. Saved places stay on your device.

Places open and close, and resort towns close between seasons, so check before you go. Spot a mistake? Email nick@eatsranked.com.

An independent app, not affiliated with any restaurant, team, university, chain or government agency, or the James Beard Foundation. James Beard Foundation and James Beard Award are trademarks of the James Beard Foundation. Place data from Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA Permissive 2.0) and others; sources and licenses are on the About tab.

reviewNotes:
1. Purpose and audience: Idaho Eats is a free guide to restaurants in Idaho. Its focus is the state's own food: Basque kitchens on Boise's Basque Block, finger steaks and drive-ins, spud plates, huckleberry, Idaho trout, taquerías and historic saloons, each place checked by hand in fall 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source (the restaurant's own website or menu, or local news), plus Idaho's James Beard Foundation honorees, as facts. It also lists 4,006 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries statewide. It is for Idaho residents and visitors deciding where to eat. No ads, account or tracking.

2. How to use it (no login, no setup, no sample files needed):
- Home → any guide (Basque, Finger Steaks & Drive-Ins, Spud Plates, Huckleberry, Idaho Trout, Taquerías, Historic Saloons, James Beard Honors, Oldest Places, Near Me) → tap a place.
- On a place, tap "Ratings, hours & photos" to open Apple Maps' own place card through MapKit. Directions, Call and Website are below it.
- Search by name, town, street or dish ("finger steaks boise", "huckleberry").
- The Map tab shows the Idaho picks, Finger Steaks, Basque and Honors guides as pins, plus nearby restaurants once zoomed in to a town. "My location" and the Nearest sort use location only if allowed, on the device.
- The heart saves a place on the device, under the Saved tab. The About tab lists the data sources, licenses and the independence statement.
- On iPad, a sidebar replaces the tabs; a place opens in the right-hand column.
- Outside Idaho (as App Review usually is), the map says so and stays on Idaho.

3. External services and data:
- Apple MapKit: maps, local search to find a place's Apple Maps listing, and Apple's place card for live hours, photos and ratings.
- Core Location: optional, on-device only, for distance sorting.
- Core Spotlight: on-device indexing so places appear in iPhone search.
- No backend, accounts, analytics, advertising, payments or AI services. The restaurant data is bundled in the app.
- Bundled data: Overture Maps open data (CDLA Permissive 2.0 and Apache 2.0; license texts in the app); James Beard honors (facts only); and our own research of restaurants' websites, menus and local news.
- Privacy policy and support: a static site on GitHub Pages, https://nickstrom5.github.io/idaho-eats/

4. Regional differences: none. The content covers Idaho; the app works the same everywhere in the United States.

5. Regulated or protected material: the app is not in a regulated industry and includes no protected third-party material. The data is open-licensed or public, credited on the About tab. Ratings, hours and photos are shown only inside Apple's own place card through MapKit, under Apple's terms; the app stores no ratings or reviews. Idaho's health districts don't publish inspection results in bulk, so the app shows none and links each place's district lookup instead. Honors are stated as facts, with a trademark notice. Website links were checked before release (each must be the restaurant's own page), and strip clubs and other adult venues are excluded by name, address and category. The app is independent and not affiliated with any restaurant, agency or the James Beard Foundation.

Support: nick@eatsranked.com
